01 · from my heart

I'm truly, truly sorry 🥺

I understand why you were upset when I didn't properly check or respond to your messages and left you waiting. I should have treated your messages and your time with more care.

Dear Nidhu, 💗

I am extremely, extremely sorry for not replying properly, for missing your messages, and for making you feel ignored. I understand that it can feel hurtful when you make time for someone and they don't give your messages the attention they deserve.

I don't want to brush this off with excuses. I hear what you're telling me, and I accept that I need to be more thoughtful and communicate better.

I'm sorry, Nidhu. I want my actions to show that I mean this — not just a pretty website or nice words. 🌷

With a sincere sorry,
Me 💌

02 · a promise of respect

“Nidhu, your time matters. Your feelings matter. Your priorities deserve respect — always.”

07 · a letter for you

Thank you for telling me 💌

Nidhu, I know you also give me time, attention and priority, and I don't want to take that for granted. I'm sorry that my actions didn't reflect the care I should have shown when you messaged me.

I want to get better at communicating with you, being considerate, and respecting your time. If I can't reply straight away, I can at least make an effort to explain instead of leaving you wondering.

You don't have to forgive me instantly or pretend everything is okay. I wanted to acknowledge my mistake and say sorry sincerely. Thank you for being honest with me about how you felt. 🌷

10 · what sorry means to me

Not just words — real effort 🌱

An apology matters most when it changes what happens next. These are the small, practical ways I want to make things better.

💬

Communicate clearly

If I'm caught up with something, I'll try to say so instead of leaving you guessing.

👂

Listen without arguing

I'll try to hear your feelings first and understand why you were upset, rather than focusing on defending myself.

🌸

Give change time

I know trust comes from consistency. You don't have to believe a promise immediately; I'll let my actions speak over time.

Nidhu, I am sorry I made you feel ignored. I respect your time and your priorities, and I won't ask you to forgive me before you're ready. I'll focus on being more thoughtful, one small action at a time. 💗
